rubric_items.reason: Built on the existing repo, service, route, types, page and format.ts, adds no infrastructure. But it puts not_seen parsing in the route and the flag in client.ts, while the code parses list queries in the service and the page builds the params.
Every story S-1 to S-6 maps to components, and the time rules cover S-2 AC2-AC4 (local today, calendar months, clamping). Never-visited exclusion, paging and total are served.

Each EP-1 field has a name, type, nullability, format and example. Where the code changes is less exact: CO-2 and CO-3 both claim not_seen, CO-6 needs no edit, and the PatientsPage filters object is not named.
Every choice is cited or decided by A-05 to A-08. A-08 asked something client.ts already answers, and C14's 'flag is added there' does not match the generic params passthrough.

Explains the trade-offs of the lateral join, the service-side cutoff, clamping, strict not_seen and the page reset. It gives no reason for moving query parsing into the route, which breaks the existing service-side Fields pattern.
Clear and well ordered. CO-2 and CO-3 overlap on who reads and validates not_seen.
